# AONIC TECH Private Limited

> AONIC TECH is a dual-niche enterprise delivering end-to-end Digital Solutions & Software and Industrial Specialty Materials Import & Supply under one roof.

## Core Divisions

### 1. Digital Solutions & Software
- **Custom Web & App Development**: Next.js, React, Node.js modern responsive architectures.
- **POS & Billing Software**: Retail, restaurant, and enterprise point-of-sale systems with offline capabilities and real-time reporting.
- **E-Commerce & Digital Platforms**: Scalable e-commerce stores with payment gateways and automated inventory management.
- **Brand Strategy & Design**: Identity design, UI/UX prototyping, packaging, and commercial digital assets.

### 2. Industrial Materials Import & Supply
- **Titanium & Specialty Alloys**: Certified aerospace and medical grade titanium (Grade 2, Grade 5 / Ti-6Al-4V), stainless alloys, and raw rods/sheets.
- **Rare-Earth Magnets**: Industrial Neodymium (NdFeB), Samarium-Cobalt (SmCo), and custom permanent magnetic assemblies.
- **Electronic IC & Component Sourcing**: Hard-to-find microcontrollers, power management ICs, and passive components with verified authenticity.
- **Low-MOQ & Doorstep Delivery**: Customs clearance, laboratory mill test certificates (MTC), and doorstep delivery across India.
